items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Ross Konikoff was in the band.

ctx.x: The time that you were following him around, was that the big band, like with Don Menza and—
Yeah. So I was seventeen, eighteen, so that’s ’78. Yeah 1978. Ross Konikoff was in the band. Steve Marcus.
Yeah. It was a little after the time I was thinking of, but Menza was earlier of course.
